sections.title: Section 1 — Introduction & The SMB Problem
sections.action: Start on homepage. Show header logo, problem headline, voice audition chips, and Gnani attribution.
sections.script: Hello judges! I am Gowtham, presenting Vaani Recap — an autonomous multilingual AI cold calling and lead briefing agent built for over 63 million Indian SMBs. Vaani Recap automates outbound calling, transcribes regional calls, and delivers an audio evening recap under 60 words.

sections.title: Section 2 — Live Dashboard & Outbound Dialing
sections.action: Navigate to Dashboard. Highlight Verified Caller ID (+91 98765 43210), 6 live metrics, and click 'Dial Next Prospect'.
sections.script: Here is the live Dashboard. Outbound calls route through the owner's verified forwarding number, showing a trusted caller ID. When I click Dial Next Prospect, the AI agent initiates the cold call using our sector campaign script and engages the customer.

sections.title: Section 3 — Call Recordings & Multi-Voice Dialogue
sections.action: Click Recordings. Hit Play on a call to hear contrasting agent & customer voices. Point out verbatim STT transcript & budget.
sections.script: In Recordings, every call is synthesized using Gnani Timbre v3.0 with distinct, contrasting voices for agent and customer without repetition. Simultaneously, Gnani Prisma STT transcribes the call, capturing customer intent and budget.

sections.title: Section 4 — Spoken Evening Brief & Lead Card
sections.action: Click Play on Today's Spoken Recap (<60 words). Click 'View lead card' to show extracted quotes & one-click WhatsApp.
sections.script: At day end, owners listen to our Spoken Evening Brief under 60 words, synthesized with Gnani Timbre, highlighting won deals and callbacks. Clicking any prospect opens their structured Lead Card with objection quotes and a one-click WhatsApp follow-up.

sections.title: Section 5 — 10 Language Modes & Submission Closing
sections.action: Show 10 Indian Language Modes, 16+ Timbre voices, SQLite zero-billing cache, and close with thank you.
sections.script: In Settings, Vaani Recap supports 10 Indian language modes across Telugu, Hinglish, Hindi, and Tamil, with over 16 verified Gnani Timbre voices. Audio hashes are cached in SQLite for zero duplicate billing. Thank you!
